correctness.rationale: For every cyclic length-h run segment, decomposition into complete cycles and a remainder bounds one-run sums by the h largest and zero-run sums by the h smallest. Thus the first t ones of the sorted word occupy a no-longer span than t consecutive ones of any competing word. Every factor is dominated at every length, and the canonical prefix attains equality. An independent enumerator checked all cyclic windows in 819 small arrangement cases; no inference from finite to infinite was used.
